headline: Quarterly earnings per share jump on the year
summary_short: Quarterly EPS was CNY 0.96 versus CNY 0.37 a year ago, up 159.2%, and up 59.8% from CNY 0.60 in the prior quarter.
summary_long: Earnings per share of CNY 0.96 compares with CNY 0.37 a year earlier and CNY 0.60 last quarter.
